evidence.observation: O2 baseline ~4-5 ppm at start of growth after clean purge
O2 climbing monotonically 4.6→13.2→19.4→27.1→33.2 ppm during growth
Pressure steady ~761 Torr, Ar flow on setpoint, so rise is not a flow/exhaust change
Temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control nominal
